# Pho Viet Barcelona

> Pho Viet is an authentic, family-run Vietnamese restaurant in Barcelona, Spain, in the Eixample district (Carrer de Viladomat, 56, 08015 Barcelona). It specialises in beef Phở made with a broth slow-cooked for 12 hours, plus Vietnamese street food such as Bún Bò Huế, Bánh Xèo, Bún Chả Hà Nội and Gỏi Cuốn. Open every day; weekday lunch menu €13.90.

## Key facts

- Name: Pho Viet Barcelona (Phở Việt)
- Type: Vietnamese restaurant
- Address: Carrer de Viladomat, 56, Eixample, 08015 Barcelona, Spain
- Phone / reservations: +34 632 501 335
- Email: tranngoctuando@gmail.com
- Opening hours: Monday–Sunday, 13:00–17:00 and 19:30–23:30
- Price range: about €10–20 per person
- Lunch menu (menú del día): €13.90, Monday–Friday — starter + main course + coffee or dessert + drink (Saigon beer, homemade drinks or Vietnamese coffee +€2.00)
- Vegetarian options: many dishes available with tofu or Heura; mung bean spring rolls; vegetarian Phở
- Languages of the website: Spanish, English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pho+Viet+Carrer+de+Viladomat+56+08015+Barcelona

## Signature dishes

- Phở Bò: Hanoi-style beef noodle soup, broth simmered 12 hours with toasted ginger, shallots, star anise, cinnamon and black cardamom
- Bún Bò Huế: spicy lemongrass beef noodle soup from the imperial city of Huế
- Bánh Xèo: crispy turmeric and rice-flour crepe with pork, prawns and bean sprouts, wrapped in lettuce and herbs
- Bún Chả Hà Nội: charcoal-grilled pork with rice noodles, herbs and dipping sauce
- Gỏi Cuốn: fresh rice-paper rolls
- Chả Giò: crispy fried spring rolls (pork or mung bean)
